basic_details.job_title: IIM Lucknow Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow (IIM Lucknow) has one position of Research Assistant in its Finance & Accounting Area, under Prof. Jalaj Pathak. The post carries a fellowship of Rs.40,000/- consolidated per month plus HRA as per applicable norms. It is purely contractual, for an initial period of 11 months. Candidates need a Postgraduate degree/MBA (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks. To apply, fill in the Google Form linked in the notice by 30 October 2026, up to 5.00 PM.

qualification.details: Postgraduate degree/MBA from a reputed institute or university (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks.

how_to_apply: Applications are made only by filling in the Google Form at the link printed in the notice: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdAGaqQnWGUTK8ZNRrrVdk_j5Xt71KFVQ65TFmoJde7aylk_Q/viewform?usp=dialog. The form must be submitted by 30 October 2026, up to 5.00 PM. Applications received after the last date, and incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.
important_instructions: Incomplete or ineligible applications will be deemed invalid and rejected without informing the candidate. Only selected candidates will be informed. No other query will be entertained. Canvassing in any form will lead to immediate disqualification of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: About IIM Lucknow Research Assistant
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Management Lucknow is a management institute at Prabandh Nagar, IIM Road, Lucknow — 226013 (U.P.), India. This post is in the institute's Finance & Accounting Area, where the selected candidate will support the research of Prof. Jalaj Pathak.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Postgraduate degree/MBA from a reputed institute or university (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks. Strong data analysis skill Proficiency in R/Python/STATA Excellent command of spoken and written English Literature review and consolidation skill For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, check the official notification. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected Research Assistant will receive a fellowship of Rs.40,000/- consolidated per month. HRA is paid on top of this, as per applicable norms. The position is purely contractual. The appointment is for an initial period of 11 months, which may be extended further based on performance and institute requirements.

content_sections.heading: IIM Lucknow Research Assistant Job Description
content_sections.text: The Research Assistant will assist the faculty member in research, including but not limited to: Conducting literature reviews Conceptualizing, designing and conducting research projects Secondary data analysis Writing academic reports and papers The notice says the position is well suited for individuals planning to pursue a PhD and seeking rigorous research exposure and academic development.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Lucknow Research Assistant
content_sections.text: Applications are made only by filling in the Google Form at the link printed in the notice: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdAGaqQnWGUTK8ZNRrrVdk_j5Xt71KFVQ65TFmoJde7aylk_Q/viewform?usp=dialog. The form must be submitted by 30 October 2026, up to 5.00 PM. Applications received after the last date, and incomplete applications, will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIM Lucknow Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy: one position of Research Assistant in the Finance & Accounting Area, under Prof. Jalaj Pathak.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date is 30 October 2026, up to 5.00 PM. Applications received after this deadline will be summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: You need a Postgraduate degree/MBA from a reputed institute or university (regular mode) with a minimum of 60% marks. Strong data analysis skill and proficiency in R/Python/STATA are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an IIM Lucknow Research Assistant?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a fellowship of Rs.40,000/- consolidated per month, plus HRA as per applicable norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is HRA paid on top of the Rs.40,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid as per applicable norms, in addition to the consolidated fellowship of Rs.40,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for IIM Lucknow Research Assistant Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the Google Form linked in the official notice by 30 October 2026, up to 5.00 PM. Incomplete applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Applications are scrutinized, and shortlisted candidates are contacted by email for an online interview. The final choice is based on qualifications, experience and the outcome of the personal interaction.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant interview online or in person?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted online only. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the IIM Lucknow Research Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The position is purely contractual, for an initial period of 11 months. It may be extended further based on performance and institute requirements.
